The '''Thisspias alcazar''' existed within the planet [[Ratamesh]]. The [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]], the leader of the [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] people traditionally lived inside the structure.

In [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]], the [[Oppo Rancisis's sister|sister]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], Blood Monarch at the time, was assassinated in the alcazar when it was stormed by terrorists.
